Fixed. `to_cents` in `ledger/currency.py` truncated float results, so `0.29 * 100` gave `28.999…` and became `28`. That made `subtotal([Line("B2", 0.29, qty=3)])` come out as 84 instead of 87.

`to_cents` now converts through `Decimal(str(amount))` and rounds half up. This also fixes any other price that float multiplication would have truncated.

pytest isn't installed here, so I ran the test functions directly. All 4 in `tests/test_totals.py` and the one in `tests/test_report.py` pass.
